lines.text: How did you get on with the hip since last time?
From last time the ache in my groin has eased off a lot.
Great. You can bump the bridges up to three sets of twelve, and add the leg lifts lying on your side that we tried today.
Swimming's fine, but leave breaststroke kick out for now.
Oh, one more thing, I forgot to mention I had previous surgery on that hip when I was twenty.
Ah, that's useful. Do you know what they did?
Okay, I'll add that in. Thanks for coming back.
